// diagnostic

E0150

`{op}` needs `{type}` in state `{required}`, but `{value}` is in state `{current}`.

What

`{op}` needs `{type}` in state `{required}`, but `{value}` is in state `{current}`.

Why

Typestate (D-STATE1): an operation is valid only in a given state; calling it out of order is the bug typestate prevents.

Fix

Transition the value into `{required}` first — call the transition that reaches it (e.g. `pay` to reach `Confirmed`).

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0150: tests/ui/protocol_out_of_order.stderr.

Error [E0150]: `Charge` needs `Payment.Client` in state `S2`, but `h1` is in state `S1`
  --> tests/ui/protocol_out_of_order.jet:18:8
    |
 18 |     h1.Charge(500) ?? panic("charge failed")
    |        ^^^^^^
 Why: Typestate (D-STATE1): `Charge` is only valid in state `S2`; calling it in `S1` is the out-of-order-events bug it prevents
 Fix: Transition it first: call `recv_Ack` to reach `S2`
